conflicts.fact: Where graphite's delocalised electrons are located and what bonding holds graphite together
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 describes graphite as strong covalent bonds within layers plus Van der Waals forces between layers, with conductivity from delocalised electrons within layers. Lesson 5 says delocalised electrons exist between the carbon layers. Lessons 7 and 8 say they move along or within each layer.
